Name: Better Slingshots
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod makes slingshots better. It adds full auto fire, auto reload, better aiming, fixes bugs, and more!
Description:
Better Slingshots

**This mod:**

*   Adds automatic firing for the master and galaxy slingshots (you can also make the basic one auto fire). Better slingshots fire faster.

*   Lets every slingshot automatically reload the same ammo it was firing when it runs out.

*   Lets you aim exactly where your mouse is (no inverse aiming).

*   Makes the galaxy slingshot obtainable for 50000 tokens in the casino. It deals the most damage and fires the fastest.

*   Fixes the non-exact aiming bug in the base game.

*   Fixes the ammo being consumed even when the slingshot doesn't fire bug in the base game.
**To fire an automatic slingshot:**

1.  Press and hold down your use tool button (By default, left click) to bring up the slingshot.

2.  Press and hold down your action button (By default, right click) to fire it.
**Fully multiplayer compatible! Other people's animations might look a bit weird when they're firing the slingshot, that's normal.**

**Config options (options in bold are default):**

*   _DisableReverseAiming_: **true**/false: Makes projectiles fire at your mouse instead of the inverse position.

*   _AutoReload_: **true**/false: Whether to auto reload or not.

*   _AutomaticSlingshots_: **["Galaxy", "Master"]:** A comma separated list of names of slingshots to be made automatic. To add the normal slingshot, add "Basic" to the list.

*   _ShowActualMousePositionWhenAiming_: **true**/false: Whether to also show the red target at the mouse's position while aiming.
**Cheaty Config options (all disabled by default):**

*   _CanMoveWhileFiring_: true/**false**: Lets you move while aiming. Note that your character sprite won't animate so it will look weird.

*   _InfiniteAmmo_: true/**false**: Shooting doesn't take up ammo. You still need at least one ammo in the slot though.

*   _RapidFire_: true/**false**: All automatic slingshots fire twice as fast.

*   _GalaxySlingshotPrice_: **50000**: The number of tokens it costs to purchase the galaxy slingshot from the casino.
Requires [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) by Pathoschild.

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
